# re2

Linear-time regular expressions for Dart via Google's RE2 over FFI. Immune to catastrophic backtracking (ReDoS).

pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/re2
source: https://github.com/Yusufihsangorgel/re2

## Before you call it

AGENTS.md in the repository root is written for you. It carries the contracts that are easy to get wrong — native-handle disposal, `maxBytes`, unsupported syntax, UTF-16 offsets, rewrite escaping, `Re2Set` output, and the VM-only platform boundary — along with complete `Re2` and `Re2Set` usage from runnable examples.

It also says when ordinary `RegExp` is the better tool and how to run the two-way comparison. Read that decision before adding the dependency.

## Layout

- `lib/re2.dart` — public exports: `Re2`, `Re2Match`, `Re2Set`
- `example/` — runnable matching, ruleset, and ReDoS examples
- `bench/compare.dart` — catastrophic and ordinary `RegExp` / `Re2` comparison
- `test/` — the suite; run `dart test`
